_comment: Source of truth for every printed card batch. Add a batch = add an object below and push; the deploy regenerates the edge table. Only `id` and `destination` ever reach the edge — the rest is for your own queries (tools/scans.py joins on id).

batches.headline: EXAMPLE — replace before printing
batches.location: EXAMPLE — where this batch was handed out
batches.notes: destination:null means the batch uses default_destination. Set an absolute https URL to override it for this batch only.
